acceptanceObjective: Build the motion certification pipeline for imported external candidates: an offline probe playback mode that captures timed multi-parameter frame sequences on the Fuxuan model, packet freezing with per-candidate semantic boundary claims, dual-model review, and promotion of the first fully passing candidate into a certification record registered at the admission hub with parallel-resource arbitration.
notes: Uncertified candidates can never enter production admission: certification playback runs only in the isolated probe window. Semantic boundary claims are declared per candidate and carried inside the packet; reviewers read them from the packet. Registry admission is data-level until a production executor exists.
